import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference between outcome groups)
    effect_sizes = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        group0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, col_idx]
        group1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, col_idx]
        effect_size = abs(np.mean(group1) - np.mean(group0))
        effect_sizes.append(effect_size)
    
    # Rank features by effect size
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1]
    
    # Take top 2 features as drivers
    drivers = tuple([feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS]])
    
    # For regression, use features with effect size > 0.3
    columns = tuple([feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices if effect_sizes[i] > 0.3])
    
    # No products
    products = ()
    
    # Loadings based on effect sizes
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if effect_sizes[i] > 0.3:
            loadings[fid] = effect_sizes[i]
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
